run_pixel_unshuffle: run pixel_unshuffle on a PyTorch tensor with a given scale factor to down-sample spatially
test_pixel_unshuffle: test pixel_unshuffle with a tensor whose height and width are divisible by the scale factor
review_pixel_unshuffle: review pixel_unshuffle to understand how it reshapes and permutes tensor dimensions for downsampling
refactor_pixel_unshuffle: refactor pixel_unshuffle to use torch.nn.PixelUnshuffle instead of manual view and permute operations
summarize_pixel_unshuffle: summarize pixel_unshuffle which performs spatial-to-channel downsampling by rearranging tensor elements
